answer: On an island exchange for quartz and basalt, a swarm of buyer agents must not advertise bids backed by the same money. Before publishing each bid, atomically reserve its full price times quantity in escrow. Partial fills reduce that reservation; cancellation removes the bid before releasing funds. Every alias draws on genuinely funded balances, so splitting one budget across keys cannot multiply executable buying power. This limits phantom liquidity from unfunded Sybil orders, although funded spoofing and rapid cancellations still need separate controls.
